*The image is a screenshot of a news article from 'Andhra Pradesh Main' dated 11/09/2025, Page 2. The article discusses a record in the state of Andhra Pradesh regarding the issuance of loans by the government. The text highlights that in 2014, the state government issued loans worth a total of Rs. 1,40,717 crores to various entities, including the State Bank of India (SBI), Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (APICL), and the Andhra Pradesh Housing Board (APHB). The loans were primarily used for the construction of housing projects and other infrastructure development. The article also mentions that the loans were disbursed in the form of loans and grants, with a total of Rs. 1,40,717 crores. The text includes a table showing the details of the loans, including the amount disbursed, the purpose of the loan, and the percentage of the loan that was disbursed. The article also provides a breakdown of the loans by the year of disbursement, showing that the majority of the loans were disbursed in 2014-19. The article concludes by stating that the loans were disbursed to various entities, including the State Bank of India, Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation, and the Andhra Pradesh Housing Board.*
